messages:
michael: Quick sync — thinking about a dynamic cutover safety layer for A/B playouts that can do automatic fallback when a variant degrades. Idea: soft-leases + short probe windows to avoid noisy flips.
anya: TL;DR — sounds right. can you sketch failure modes? :thinking:
michael: Failure modes: 1) transient latency spikes causing aborts, 2) silent quality regressions (low confidence but not errors), 3) cascading KV cache misses when we switch back and forth.
kevin: Also race between affinity pins and rollout window. If session pinned to canary and we flip, sticky clients might keep hitting bad variant.
lina: For sticky sessions we should prefer in-flight finish then pin-to-stable on next request. That avoids mid-request model swap.
anya: What signals? latency p95, error rate, model-confidence drift (log-prob), DETECTED semantic degradation via small eval set.
michael: Propose policy fields: "min-exposure", "probe-window-secs", "rollback-thresholds": {"p95_ms":"+200","err_pct":"+1.5"}, "semantic-checks": {"eval-set":"smoke-100"}
kevin: config idea (pseudo-YAML):
```
policy:
  min_exposure: 60
  probe_window_secs: 30
  thresholds:
    p95_ms: 1.2x
    error_pct: 1.5
  semantic_eval: smoke-100
  soft_lease_secs: 120
```
product-ryan: We need to include cost/latency budget tradeoffs in the UI. PM asks for clear rollback reasons for audit.
anya: We should keep decision deterministic and observable: store last-decision-reason in rollout-events, include metrics snapshot.
kevin: Implementation notes: controller watches metrics stream, runs sliding-window aggregation per variant, emits a single decision event per probe-window. The runtime reads event and enforces route rule.
michael: Want to avoid heavy coupling to runtime. Keep decisions in a small 'selector' service that outputs an immutable decision blob consumed by routers.
devops-bot: deploy:probe check reports will be posted to #eng-oncall.
lina: Also plan for graceful cache warming after switch back: pre-warm by routing ~5% test traffic before full switch.
anya: Tests: 1) synthetic latency spike, 2) semantic regression via prompt set, 3) stickiness/race test.
kevin: Long-term: replace hard rules with learned fallback scoring (ML model predicts risk). For now keep simple rules.
michael: Action items: write RFC draft with config schema + sequence diagrams, I can own RFC. kevin and anya to review. Lina to add sticky-session playbook.
anya: SGTM :thumbsup:
kevin: will comment by EOD tomorrow.
product-ryan: add audit logging requirement to RFC.
michael: thanks — filing RFC draft today. We'll sync next Tue 10am. :calendar:
